_meta.description: Influence-network organizations frequently behind coordinated narratives. Every entry links to primary-source receipts (990 filings, court records, investigative databases). Scale figures are approximate annual revenue from public 990s and dated. This file documents; the receipts prove.
_meta.dark_money_note: 'Dark money' here means 501(c) entities that spend on politics without disclosing donors, and the donor-advised funds (DonorsTrust et al.) that anonymize the money upstream.

Heritage Foundation.focus: Policy architecture for the movement right; author of Project 2025.
Heritage Foundation.funding: Bradley Foundation, Scaife funds, DonorsTrust conduit, corporate donors.

ALEC.focus: Model legislation copy-pasted into state law; corporations vote on drafts alongside legislators.
ALEC.funding: Corporate members and conservative foundations; membership lists partially exposed by leaks.

Alliance Defending Freedom.focus: Anti-LGBTQ and anti-abortion litigation; behind many state-level trans healthcare bans.
Alliance Defending Freedom.funding: Large anonymous gifts via National Christian Foundation and DonorsTrust.

Family Research Council.type: 501(c)(3), reclassified as 'association of churches' (2020) — exempting it from filing public 990s

Heartland Institute.focus: Climate denial's institutional home; historically tobacco-doubt as well.
Heartland Institute.funding: Historically ExxonMobil and Koch funds; now heavily DonorsTrust-anonymized.

Manhattan Institute.focus: Home of the engineered CRT panic (Christopher Rufo, who described the strategy on the record: 'decodify the term and recodify it').

Claremont Institute.focus: Intellectual scaffolding for election-denial ('John Eastman memos') and post-liberal politics.

Turning Point USA.focus: Campus and youth narrative distribution; enormous social media amplification apparatus.

PragerU.focus: Short-form ideological video at industrial scale; approved as classroom material in several states.
PragerU.funding: Founding funding: fracking billionaires Farris and Dan Wilks.

Center for Immigration Studies.focus: Restrictionist immigration statistics laundered into mainstream debate; founded within the Tanton network.

FAIR (Federation for American Immigratio.focus: Anti-immigration advocacy; Tanton network flagship; historic Pioneer Fund (eugenics) funding.

ICAN (Informed Consent Action Network).focus: Anti-vaccine media (Del Bigtree); majority of historic funding from a single family (Selz).

Children's Health Defense.focus: Anti-vaccine litigation and media; founded by RFK Jr., who became HHS Secretary in 2025 — the org's narratives now carry federal force.

State Policy Network.focus: Makes identical policy narratives appear locally grown in every state simultaneously — institutionalized coordination.

DonorsTrust / Donors Capital Fund.focus: Anonymization layer: donors give here, DonorsTrust regrants to movement orgs, original source vanishes from every downstream 990.

Bradley Foundation.focus: Patient capital for the infrastructure: Heritage, election-integrity litigation networks, state think tanks.

Americans for Prosperity.focus: Field operation + ad spending; the network's donor summits move more money than most parties.

The 85 Fund / Leonard Leo network.type: 501(c)(3)/(c)(4) constellation (85 Fund, Marble Freedom Trust, Concord Fund)
The 85 Fund / Leonard Leo network.scale: Marble Freedom Trust seeded with $1.6B (largest known dark-money gift in US history, Barre Seid, 2021)
The 85 Fund / Leonard Leo network.focus: Judicial confirmations, election litigation, state AG races — narrative campaigns timed to court fights.

Media Research Center.focus: 'Media bias' meta-narrative production — the machine that pre-discredits fact-checking itself.

Moms for Liberty.focus: School-board narrative insertion; grassroots-styled with major-donor and Heritage-adjacent backing.

Conservative Partnership Institute.focus: Staffing and infrastructure hub for election-denial personnel (Mark Meadows, Cleta Mitchell's Election Integrity Network).
